description: Bangor Bypass : environmental impact statement : comprising the East-West Link (Akuna Avenue to Old Illawarra Road) and the North-South Link (New Illawarra Road to Alfords Point Road) : volume 1 is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Government. It is proposed to construct a four line high standard limited access road known as the Bangor bypass, comprising two sections: the east-west link between the western approaches of the Woronora Bridge and Old Illawarra Road, and the north-south link between Alfords Point Road and the New Illawarra Road. The licence is licence code "lsba" on the portal (not expanded on the listing).
